marco: Heads-up: finalizing joint perf/W lab run with Delta HW next week. Need config checklist + telemetry hooks.

ravi: Thanks. Are we doing warmup/preconditioned KV cache or cold-start only?

carmen: Both — we'll sweep cold vs warm and two quant levels. Need to pin memfreq & thermal profiles.

sasha: I'll add telemetry tags: rack_id, pdu_id, fan_curve, nvlink_topo. Also will push new dashboards.

partner_bot: Delta HW testbed reserved for 2026-04-12..14 — confirm availability and on-site engineer.

marco: @sasha can you attach the runbook snippet + minimal playbook? want quick handoff for Delta.

sasha: Uploading runbook snippet: ```env: ubuntu-22.04
kernel: 5.19
nvidia-driver: 535.86
powercap: 250W
batcher: dynamic
quant: int8/int4
metrics: power_w, tokens/s, p99_latency
```

ravi: We'll need to validate kernel modules for the optimized attention kernels. @carmen can you run `modinfo rdm-accel` on the test node and share output?

carmen: on it. Also let's agree on the golden prompt set for throughput/regression — I'll seed 50 prompts (short, long, multi-turn).

marco: Schedule draft: 4/12 baseline cold, 4/13 kernel tuning + perf/W sweep, 4/14 final verification + tech note prep. Partner PR tentative 4/21.

sasha: :thumbsup: I'll create dashboards and a canary alert if power > expected+10%. Will tag metrics as `delta_lab.v1`.

partner_bot: Reminder: share NDAed thermals csv via secure bucket: s3://redwood-partners/delta/thermals (use presigned link for partner access).

ravi: Question: do we include a mixed-workload run (chat + embeddings) to reflect real PLG traffic?

carmen: Yes. Mixed run at 30/70 chat/embeddings ratio to mimic PLG traffic. We'll do that on 4/13 after kernel tune.

marco: OK, action items: sasha -> dashboards + runbook, carmen -> prompts + mixed workload harness, ravi -> kernel validation + autotuner params, I'll prep press draft and partner comms. Ping here when done.

sasha: Got it. I'll post a tiny README after dashboards are uploaded (link will be internal).

carmen: modinfo returned: rdm-accel v1.2.3, no issues. Sharing node logs shortly.

ravi: Noted — starting autotuner sweep today, will post compact CSVs (kernels x power x tokens/s).

partner_bot: Booking confirmed. Delta engineer @alex (delta) joins 4/12 9am PT for kickoff.

marco: Perfect. Thanks team.
